name: Parquet Viewer
description: Opens Apache Parquet files in the editor: a fast data grid with sort, filter and export, the schema, and file details with per-column statistics.

cover.alt: Parquet Viewer in Orca: a grid of hourly weather readings with typed column headers

screenshots.alt: The data grid with station, city, time and temperature columns in Orca's dark theme
screenshots.caption: Browse wide and long files; only the rows on screen are decoded

screenshots.caption: Browse wide and long files; only the rows on screen are decoded

screenshots.alt: Rows filtered by the word lightning: 527 of 70,080 rows match, showing list and struct columns
screenshots.caption: Filter rows across the whole file, nested columns included
